title: Harmonize quickstart hero assets and inline screenshots for dark mode accessibility
creator: Ava Reynolds
description:
Scope: Perform an accessibility-first visual pass on quickstart and onboarding assets for dark theme. Deliver updated hero illustrations, inline product screenshots, and revised iconography tokens that meet WCAG AA contrast for text and interactive elements, with AAA contrast where practical for key call-to-action labels.

Goals:
- Create dark-mode variants for 6 hero/thumbnail illustrations and 12 inline screenshots used across Quickstart, New Project flow, and first-run modals.
- Update iconography to a two-weight system (filled + 2px stroke) to preserve recognition at small sizes and in low-contrast contexts.
- Produce a token mapping (old color -> new accessible color / alpha) and a short spec for engineering to apply to automated screenshot rendering.
- Provide checklist and test screenshots for QA and accessibility review.

Acceptance criteria:
- All updated assets exported in Figma with correct naming: hero/*-dark.png, screenshot/*-dark@2x.png.
- Contrast ratios: body text >= 4.5:1, UI labels >= 4.5:1, CTAs >= 3:1 (with focus/highlight variants meeting 4.5:1 on focus).
- New icons at 16px legible and visually consistent across themes.
- Designer handoff doc containing tokens, usage notes, and links to PRs and implementation tickets.

Deliverables:
- Figma file with component variants and export-ready frames.
- Design handoff doc (Drive) + small rollout checklist for Console and Docs teams.
- QA artifact: before-and-after screenshots and a11y report (axe / color contrast measurement).
comments: 2026-03-01 Ava Reynolds: Created ticket and initial scope. Quick audit highlights 6 hero images and ~12 inline screenshots where contrast drops below 3:1 in dark theme. Marked for P1 due to onboarding funnel impact.

2026-03-05 Priya Nair (PM): Prefer option B to keep product pixels unchanged. PM requests collecting pre-rollout metrics: clickthrough on CTA in onboarding (<1% lift target).

2026-03-08 Design review: Reviewed with UX and Accessibility. Decided on icon weight system: 2px stroke for outlines, 16px filled for small pins, and 24px for hero/illustrative uses. Accessibility reviewer requested focus outlines at 3px and a high-contrast hover state for keyboard navigation.
